open_points.subject: flow:service_start
open_points.text: The start has succeeded when the web server is listening.
open_points.question: What exact event makes the web server "listening": successful socket listen/bind, readiness to accept requests, completion of all server startup hooks, or some externally observable readiness signal?
options: Success immediately after the operating-system listen operation succeeds.
Success only when the server can accept and dispatch an HTTP request.
Success only after an explicit server-ready signal or startup hook completes.
open_points.default_guess: Treat successful completion of the operating-system listen operation as the success boundary.

witness.initial: The settings, token and connections file are valid, and the configured loopback port is free.
events: The web server binds the port and places its socket into the listening state.
Before it can accept or dispatch a request, a server startup hook or worker fails and the process exits.
outcomes: The start succeeded at the socket-listen event; the exit is a later web-server failure whose aftermath the deployment decides.
The start never succeeded because the server was not yet able to accept and dispatch requests; the process ended without completing startup.
witness.observer: The deployment, especially if it classifies or handles startup failures differently from failures after a successful start.
